_about: Shot library. One entry per clip; footage.py cuts them into video/public/footage/<id>.mp4 and writes src/data/footage.ts. The lip-sync clip of each voice source starts at the same second as that source's audio (usually 0). Describe every clip: the scene agents choose shots from these descriptions and qa/footage-sheet.jpg.

clips.desc: the subject talking to camera — lip-sync source of voice 'main'
